chat.body: Why does update_pokemon look the trainer up only when trainer_id is a number?

`update_pokemon()` calls `find_trainer()` only when `fields.get("trainer_id")` is not `None`. A body with `"trainer_id": null` is still in `fields`, because `exclude_unset=True` keeps a value the body sets, so the loop writes `NULL` and the Pokemon has no trainer. There is no trainer to look up in that case.
